summary: Independently verified the new 'My Wallet' child feature end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass against public URL (GET /wallet/my-wallet structure, overspend rejected 400, amount<=0 rejected 400, invalid entry_type rejected 400, income increases balance & creates manual_income entry at top, spend decreases balance & creates manual_spend entry at top). Frontend UI (Playwright): logged in as wallet_demo_child, dashboard tile jar-my_wallet navigates to /my-wallet, my-wallet-page renders with balance/month-in/month-out/Money Story ledger, ledger includes 'by me' badges for manual entries and 'waiting for payout' for unsettled auto earnings. SPEND flow (₹10, category food) decreased balance 237→227. INCOME flow (₹25, category cash) increased balance 227→252, new '+₹25 by me' entry appeared at top. Validation: submitting without amount / without category / overspend (>balance) all kept dialog open (client-side toast prevents submit). Wallet page my-wallet-card is clickable and navigates to /my-wallet. Everything is working as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: In MyWalletPage submitEntry, `!amount` is truthy for NaN (parseFloat('')), which is correctly rejected, but users entering '0' also trigger 'Please enter how much' — acceptable but message could differentiate. Non-blocking.
The overspend guard exists both client-side (toast) and server-side (400). Good defensive design.
GET /wallet/my-wallet loads up to 2000 transactions in memory then filters in Python; consider a MongoDB query with `wallet_source: 'my_wallet'` filter for scalability once ledgers grow.
seed_data_creation: Test created TEST_income (+30) and TEST_spend (-15) entries during backend tests, plus UI test entries (+25 income, -10 spend). These are visible in the ledger for wallet_demo_child.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature fully working. wallet_demo_child balance is ~₹252 after test runs (up from seeded ~₹200 due to accumulated test entries). Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_my_wallet.py.
